entries.neighbor_distinction: Experimental describes sonic/formal inquiry, abstract hip hop describes associative MC writing, and alternative hip hop is a wider non-mainstream category. entries.geo_rationale: Miami is documented as part of Watson’s recurring artist geography in his interview. This is a translocal artist-network point; Project 0 includes overseas producer collaboration and no exclusive Miami origin or tracking-room claim.
